definitions.failure: invalid replay; valid inconclusive is not failure
definitions.fairness: same frozen pool, budget, seed, exogenous feedback schedule and outcome oracle
definitions.legal_selection_rate: legal SELECT / all SELECT; verifier validates each guard
definitions.limitations: Hand-constructed synthetic cases; no population inference or L2/L3 causal claim
definitions.redundant_selections: SELECT yielding zero new verified facts, includes unknown/inconclusive
definitions.rejected_candidates: candidate evaluations failing shared guard, not adversarial rejection rate
definitions.stop_correctness: correct terminal decisions / terminal decisions, independently replayed
definitions.verified_facts: distinct (key,value) from selected VERIFIED synthetic outcomes, excludes feedback
